_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every template + style + size combination in the pipeline
_meta.status: UPDATED with Brandon's rules + transcript answers. CRITICAL: Brian says NO AI photos — use brand library only.
_meta.schema_notes: Multi-variant templates (Text Only, Reminder) use a `variants` array because Brandon ships several frame variants under one template_name. Single-variant templates keep their flat shape.

brandon_rules.hierarchy: Clear visual hierarchy with top-down reading order
brandon_rules.imagery: Human-centered or lifestyle imagery that reflects target users and use cases. Framed at center. Image bleeds to the edge of design.
brandon_rules.colors: White or black text, white or black CTA pill with white text. CTA pill (container fill) and text must be same color.
brandon_rules.value_prop: Immediate clarity of value proposition without extra explanation
brandon_rules.logo: Bottom right corner. Positioned so the logo aligns to the bottom of the CTA pill. Padding around logo must match border thickness of overall design.
brandon_rules.copy_position: Headline + CTA must be positioned in the bottom lower left of the design. Headline size can vary depending on character count. More text = smaller font.
brandon_rules.copy_coverage: Copy must not cover more than 40% of the design

image.what_pipeline_provides: Full bleed human-centered or lifestyle photo, framed at center, bleeding to edges
image.what_template_provides: Text overlay (headline + CTA) in bottom lower left, logo at bottom right, auto-adjusting layout

composition_rules.subject_position: Center of frame — Brandon says 'framed at center'
composition_rules.subject_framing: Person is the clear focal point, large and prominent
composition_rules.image_bleed: Full bleed — image goes edge to edge with no border
composition_rules.copy_zone: Bottom 40% of image will have text overlay — subject should be clearly visible above this zone
composition_rules.safe_zone: Upper 60% of image is fully unobstructed. Lower 40% has headline + CTA overlay.
composition_rules.avoid: No text, no logos, no elements in the bottom 40% that compete with copy overlay. Person's face must be in the upper 60%.

headline.auto_sizing: Headline size varies by character count. More text = smaller font.
headline.max_coverage: Copy (headline + CTA) must not cover more than 40% of the design

cta.style: Pill shape. CTA pill and text must be same color (white or black).

brand_elements.logo_position: Bottom right corner, aligned to bottom of CTA pill
brand_elements.logo_padding: Must match border thickness of overall design

brandon_rules.hierarchy: Clear visual hierarchy with top-down reading order
brandon_rules.imagery: Human-centered imagery that reflects target users and use cases. Framed at center. Image bleeds to the edge of the internal border.
brandon_rules.colors: White borders, black text, black CTA pill with white text.
brandon_rules.spacing: Balanced spacing and padding for visual clarity. Rounded corners 37.33%.
brandon_rules.value_prop: Immediate clarity of value proposition without extra explanation
brandon_rules.logo: Top right corner. Positioned at edge of corner. Padding around logo must match border thickness.
brandon_rules.copy_position: Headline + CTA must be positioned in the bottom lower left of the design.

image.what_pipeline_provides: Human-centered photo, person framed at center, image bleeds to internal border edge
image.what_template_provides: White border frame (Upwork shell), black headline + CTA in bottom left, logo at top right, rounded corners 37.33%

composition_rules.subject_position: Center of frame — Brandon says 'framed at center, image bleeds to edge of internal border'
composition_rules.subject_framing: Person centered, clear focal point. Image will be inside a white-bordered frame with rounded corners.
composition_rules.border: White borders surround the image. Image bleeds to the internal border edge, not the full frame edge.
composition_rules.copy_zone: Bottom lower left has headline + CTA. Subject should not be in the bottom left corner.
composition_rules.safe_zone: Center and upper portions of image are safe. Bottom left has text overlay.
composition_rules.avoid: No subject in bottom left corner where copy sits. No text or logos in the image.

brand_elements.logo_position: Top right corner, at edge of corner

brandon_rules._note: No rules from Brandon yet — these are still assumptions

image.what_pipeline_provides: Professional headshot, face centered, clean background
image.what_template_provides: Circular crop, star rating, quote layout, name field, Upwork logo, branded background

composition_rules.subject_framing: Head and shoulders only — image will be cropped to a small 397px circle
composition_rules.background: Clean solid color, will be mostly hidden by circular crop
composition_rules.avoid: No busy backgrounds, no body below shoulders, face must fill most of the frame

brandon_rules.imagery: No photography. Background is a gradient handled inside the template.
brandon_rules.copy_position: Headline + subhead + CTA pill stacked in the lower-left content block.

No border, green gradient bleeds to edge.

image.what_pipeline_provides: Nothing. Template owns the gradient/background and the layout. Pipeline writes copy only.

brandon_rules.layout: Two photo placeholders, one left and one right, with a copy block stacked above.
brandon_rules.copy_position: Headline + CTA pill in the top Copy Top frame.

image._dual_placeholder: This template has TWO image targets. Pipeline currently produces ONE combined dual-scene Split Screen image (see run_pipeline.py STYLE_PROMPT_TEMPLATES['Split Screen']). Until pipeline is updated to produce two separate photos, fill BOTH placeholders with the same image OR have plugin/manifest specify left/right by tag.

brandon_rules.layout: Same as 1440x1440 with taller aspect for 4:5 placements.

templates._added: 2026-05-11 — Brandon shipped 2 frame variants under Adtype: Reminder
templates._naming_quirk: Brandon ships two frame variants both named Template_Reminder_1440x1440. The size is 1440x1805 (taller than the frame name suggests). The two TEXT layers inside each variant share the name Notification_Headline_Text — one is the label ('Reminder'), one is the body — disambiguate by layer_id.

brandon_rules.format: Mobile-notification visual: rounded bubble with a Upwork logo, a 'Reminder' label, a body message, and a CTA pill.
brandon_rules.imagery: No photography. Decorative gradient handled by template.
brandon_rules.logo: Upwork glyph inside the notification bubble.

cta.role: CTA text inside pill button (e.g. 'Get started for free')
cta._note: Screenshot does not specify a hard CTA max — 32 is a working estimate based on visible layout.

image.what_pipeline_provides: Nothing. Template owns the gradient + bubble.

templates._added: 2026-05-18 — Brandon shipped first Meme template (this-is-fine dog). 3 frame variants.
templates._naming_quirk: Frames are named Template_SplitScreen_1440x1440 (Brandon reused the SplitScreen skeleton). Plugin disambiguates via STYLE_ADTYPE_CONTAINERS = 'Adtype: Meme'. Headline layer is 'SplitScreen_Headline_Text' (same reason). CTA pill exists but is HIDDEN in the design — do not write to it.
templates._meme_image_baked_in: Each meme template ships with its specific meme image baked into a layer named after the meme (e.g. 'this-is-fine 1'). There is NO swappable meme library — adding a new meme (Drake, Distracted Boyfriend, etc.) requires Brandon to ship a new template family. Pipeline does NOT provide an image for Meme.

brandon_rules.imagery: Baked-in meme image. Pipeline supplies caption only.
brandon_rules.copy_position: Caption at the top of the card, above the meme image.
brandon_rules.cta: Hidden — memes do not carry a CTA pill.
brandon_rules.logo: Upwork wordmark bottom-right corner of the meme image.

headline.role: Quote — meme caption (e.g. 'POV: Me waking up with too many messages')

cta._note: Cta Pill parent frame is hidden — do not write.

meme._note: Static — template ships with the meme baked in. Plugin must NOT overwrite.

variants.description: No outer border, meme card bleeds to edge of the cream background.

image.what_pipeline_provides: Nothing. Meme is part of the template.

LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.brandon_rule: Human-centered or lifestyle imagery. Framed at center. Image bleeds to edge. Copy covers max 40% of bottom.
LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.prompt_focus: Person is the hero. Large, prominent, center of frame. Face must be in the upper 60% of the image.
LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.person_framing: waist up, facing camera or slight angle, warm genuine expression, centered in frame
LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.background: Modern office, coworking space, clean professional environment
LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.lighting: Warm natural window light, shallow depth of field on background
LifestylePhoto_1440x1440.avoid: No text, no logos, no watermarks. Person's face must NOT be in the bottom 40% of the frame. No important subjects in lower portion.

PhotowithText_1440x1440.brandon_rule: Human-centered imagery. Framed at center. Image bleeds to internal border edge. White borders, rounded corners 37.33%.
PhotowithText_1440x1440.prompt_focus: Person centered in frame. Will be inside a white-bordered frame with rounded corners. Copy sits in bottom left.
PhotowithText_1440x1440.person_framing: chest up, centered in frame, looking at camera or at work
PhotowithText_1440x1440.avoid: No subject in bottom left corner where headline and CTA sit. No text or logos in the image.

Quote_1080x1080.prompt_focus: Tight headshot portrait. Face fills the frame. Will be cropped to tiny 397px circle.
Quote_1080x1080.person_framing: head and shoulders only, face centered, direct eye contact
Quote_1080x1080.lighting: Soft even studio lighting, sharp focus on eyes
Quote_1080x1080.avoid: No busy backgrounds, no body below shoulders, face must be centered

background_only.prompt_focus: Abstract gradient or texture. No people, no objects.
background_only.colors: Upwork green (#14a800) to dark charcoal, or warm neutral gradients. Black backgrounds perform best per KOTH data.
background_only.avoid: No text, no logos, no objects, no people
